documents.title: Statement of Work SOW-2026-031: Priya Raghunathan, perception SDK ingest reliability
documents.text:
STATEMENT OF WORK SOW-2026-031 between Northbeam Robotics and Priya Raghunathan (contractor, worker W-8841).
§1 Term. Services start on 2026-09-28 and end on 2027-03-31. All access expires on the end date, with no grace period.
§2 Scope. Improve ingest reliability in the perception SDK and extend its test harness.
§3 Repositories. Read-only access to northbeam/perception-sdk. No other repository is in scope; changes are submitted as patches reviewed by the engaging manager.
§4 Production. The contractor will not receive production credentials, production database access or customer PII exports.
§5 Owner. Engaging manager: Marc Liu (E-0120). Approver of record for repository access: the Security on-call.
§6 Paperwork. NDA signed 2026-09-10; SOW countersigned 2026-09-15.
